# IT Infrastructure Optimization and Investigation Tasks

This document details a series of critical tasks for the IT & Digital department:

*   Optimize encryption standards based on audit recommendations.
*   Investigate the database migration process quarterly.
*   Urgently investigate encryption standards.
*   Investigate API latency quarterly.
